title: Kafka Stream Listener with Spring Boot
title_es: Kafka Stream Listener con Spring Boot
description: Runnable Spring Boot 3 consumer: @KafkaListener with manual acks, @RetryableTopic non-blocking retries and a @DltHandler dead-letter sink on a KRaft broker.
